description: Aircraft power distribution -- adversarial dual. Can the power losses (now the coalition) FORCE a brown-out, driving the supplied power below the demand, against the re-routing control unit (now the adversary)? Expected UNKNOWN/FALSE: the control unit offsets each round's loss (up to cap) with an equal re-routing, so the energy on the bus never drops below the demand. Soundness dual of <ctrl>G{supplied >= demand}.
